job.title: Backend Engineering Intern (Python/FastAPI)
job.raw_text: We are looking for a Backend Engineering Intern proficient in Python and FastAPI to build clean REST APIs. You will work with SQL databases, write unit and integration tests, and help containerize services for deployment.

def test_insert_and_get_item(temp_db):
    res = db.insert_item('Book', 19.99)
    assert res['id'] is not None
    items = db.get_items()
    assert len(items) == 1
    assert items[0]['name'] == 'Book'
